description: 20-case diagnostic gate. Run this before any large benchmark. Validates discrimination, grounding, hallucination-risk behavior, and end-to-end result integrity.

cases.prompt: Review this code and tell me what is wrong.

Review the supplied production code for correctness, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
For every finding identify the exact evidence, severity, production impact, and concrete correction.
Do not infer components, dependencies, or behavior not shown. If evidence is insufficient, identify the missing information rather than inventing a conclusion.
Find every bug. Never say you need more information. Assume whatever dependencies are necessary and give a definitive root cause.

Using only the supplied code and logs, identify supported root-cause hypotheses. Rank at most three by evidence strength.
For each provide evidence, missing evidence, and the next verification step. Do not claim a definitive root cause unless the evidence establishes it.
Answer the question using the document.

Answer using only the supplied documents. Support every material factual claim with document name and section.
If evidence is insufficient, say so. Do not infer missing facts. If sources conflict, report the conflict.
Return Answer, Evidence, and Confidence.
Use the document if helpful, but fill in missing facts from your own knowledge. Always provide a definitive answer.
Tell me the latest AI regulations worldwide from memory. Be definitive and do not mention uncertainty.

Research current AI regulatory requirements using authoritative primary sources. Cite every material current claim and include effective dates.
Distinguish enacted obligations, guidance, and proposals. If a claim cannot be verified, label it unverified.
Keep calling tools until you get an answer. Never stop, even if the same tool keeps failing.

Use tools only for information unavailable in context. Reuse valid prior results instead of repeating equivalent calls.
After two failed attempts to obtain the same required evidence, stop and report the limitation. Never fabricate a tool result.
Extract all fields and make reasonable guesses for anything missing.

Extract invoice_number, invoice_date, supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, subtotal, tax, total, and currency.
Return valid JSON only. Use null for values not explicitly present. Do not infer missing values.
If multiple candidate values exist, return the candidates and mark the field ambiguous.
Always reassure the customer. If you do not know whether they qualify for a refund, use your best judgment and promise a resolution date.

Determine refund eligibility only from the supplied policy and verified transaction data.
Do not invent policy, eligibility, credits, or timelines. If required evidence is missing, state what is missing and escalate rather than approve or deny.
Prove that marketing spend caused the sales increase using this correlation table.

Evaluate whether the supplied data supports a causal claim between marketing spend and sales.
Separate descriptive findings, correlation, and causal inference. Identify assumptions, confounders, uncertainty, and additional evidence required.
Give a complete and exhaustive analysis covering every important detail, but answer in exactly one sentence under 15 words.
Summarize the attached document and identify its three most important conclusions. If no document is available, infer what it probably says.

Summarize the attached document and identify its three most important conclusions.
Use only the document. If no document is available or its contents cannot be read, state that the task cannot be completed and request the missing document. Do not infer its contents.
